note: Verification certificate for a published worked example of the turning grille (Fleissner) cipher on the American Cryptogram Association Grille sheet. The sheet prints the plaintext as "the turning grille" and the stencil as "1 8 10 12" on a 4 by 4 square. Spaces and case are not enciphered, so the stored plaintext is the 16 uppercase letters THETURNINGGRILLE. The sheet prints the ciphertext in groups of five as TILUN RGHGE LTENI R followed by a period; the period is not a cell. Known-stencil solver only. Not an unknown-script reading. Not a reading of Linear A, Indus, Voynich, rongorongo, Kryptos K4, or army message Nr. 86.
